description.id: The unique identifier for the popover. Its needed for the feature to work properly.
description.type: The type of the popover. Valid value is 'auto'.
description.horizontalPlacement: The horizontal placement of the popover relative to its trigger element. Valid values are 'left', 'right' or 'center'.
description.verticalPlacement: The vertical placement of the popover relative to its trigger element. Valid values are 'top', 'center' or 'bottom'.
description.relativeToTrigger: Determines if the popover should be positioned relative to its trigger element. Valid values are true or false.
